visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men are seated in an indoor room with a professional microphone positioned between them. The man on the left, in a white shirt, holds a large, flaky croissant close to the microphone. The man on the right, in a blue sweater, watches intently. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the man on the right as he leans in and takes a large bite of the croissant. (3) The shot returns to the original medium framing. The man on the left continues holding the pastry while speaking softly, his hand gesturing slightly. (4) A close-up shows the man on the right speaking with a gentle expression. (5) The man on the left breaks off a small piece of the croissant and feeds it directly to the man on the right, who smiles and chews. (6) Both men look directly at the camera in a final medium shot, holding the remaining pastry.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice introduces the session in a very low-volume, breathy ASMR whisper, accompanied by the sharp, mid-frequency rustling of a paper bag. (2) A loud, highly percussive crunching sound occurs as someone bites into a crisp object, characterized by a wide spectral bandwidth and sharp transients. (3) The first male voice returns in a hushed whisper, describing the food with high breathiness and slow speech rate. (4) A second male voice responds with a similarly low-arousal whisper. (5) The first voice whispers a playful question about feeding. (6) Crunchy chewing sounds continue, followed by the second voice whispering 'Delicieux' with clear articulation. (7) The session ends with a final breathy whispered sign-off from the first speaker.
